payload.rebuttal: fixed: The criterion-b session scripted the identical bad text for both its first turn and its re-prompt turn, so the first turn's exception and the re-prompt's exception stringified to the same text. Swapping which one the error message names was then invisible to the test. I changed the re-prompt's scripted answer to a different malformed body (invalid JSON instead of a missing output block), which fails for a different reason, and updated the expected error text to match. I verified by hand that reverting the fix (naming the first turn's cause instead of the second's) now fails this test, and the committed code is back to its unmutated state.
